name: Four Seasons Hotel Montreal
insider_take: Montreal's crown jewel of luxury sits at the heart of the Golden Square Mile, where world-class art, haute cuisine, and effortless bilingual sophistication converge under one iconic roof.
whats_special: Perched in the prestigious Golden Square Mile district, the hotel offers stunning views of Mount Royal and direct access to Montreal's legendary underground city network. Home to MARCUS , the celebrated restaurant by chef Marcus Samuelsson, blending French-Canadian ingredients with global flavors in a stunning two-story space. The hotel features an exceptional art collection showcasing over 600 works by prominent Québécois and Canadian artists, making it a cultural destination in its own right. The spa spans an impressive 18,000 sq ft, featuring a rooftop pool with panoramic city views — a rare urban luxury in downtown Montreal.
pro_tip: Book a rooftop pool cabana during summer months for breathtaking views of Mont-Royal at sunset — it books out fast, so reserve well in advance. Also, ask the concierge about private access to the hotel's curated art tour for a truly unique Montreal experience.
dont_miss: Café Birks next door — a stunning heritage space inside the iconic Birks Building perfect for a Montreal-style brunch. A stroll to Mount Royal Park , just minutes away, designed by the same landscape architect as New York's Central Park, Frederick Law Olmsted. The vibrant Quartier des Spectacles arts district, a short walk away, hosting world-famous events like the Montreal Jazz Festival.
pros: Prime downtown location in Golden Square Mile
cons: Urban setting with limited outdoor space
